description: Reserve one Location floor for the authenticated owner and create a fixed 55 USDC native-USDC x402 exact Payment Intent.
name: create_payment_intent
title: Create a Mainnet Payment Intent

description: Create a short-lived owner login link for an existing 55 USDC Intent. Show the URL to the owner; wait for their Phantom wallet connection before preparing. Never request a token or private key. Do not automatically retry.
name: create_wallet_handoff

description: Check a virtual floor for the authenticated owner without disclosing another owner's identity.
name: get_floor_availability
title: Check virtual floor availability

description: Read server-recorded settlement evidence for this handoff without sending, observing the chain or repairing a payment. settlement_recorded is historical evidence, not proof of currently active service. Unknown/review results require operator review. Never resend automatically.
name: get_wallet_payment_status

description: List the authenticated owner's contracts. Only current active paid contracts with valid assent include their snapshotted mailbox address. Private forwarding destinations are omitted.
name: list_contracts
title: List authenticated owner contracts

description: Read the authenticated owner's durable event Inbox after an optional cursor.
name: list_events
title: Read durable Agent events

description: List safe Location summaries and virtual floor ranges using the connected Google OAuth account. Exact addresses are never included in this catalog.
name: list_locations
title: List Location summaries

description: After the owner connects Phantom, prepare the immutable transaction for this handoff. Then ask the owner to review and sign in the existing owner page. This does not sign or send. Do not automatically retry or request a replacement after expiry.
name: prepare_wallet_signature

description: Only after the owner explicitly signs the 55 USDC payment in Phantom, submit the server-saved proof once. Acknowledgement is not settlement. Always follow with get_wallet_payment_status; never automatically retry submission, including after a timeout.
name: submit_wallet_payment
